config.description: Bearer token using your Signal8 API key (e.g. "Bearer sk_live_…"). API keys are included with Signal8 Pro; create one at https://signal8.ai/developer/api-keys. Clients that support MCP OAuth (e.g. Claude custom connectors) can omit this header and sign in with their Signal8 account instead.
